Create a silent-first X launch film that introduces Proofpress as the open trust
layer for multiplayer AI. The category claim is earned through one concrete
proof: a file crosses from Session A to Session B with its admitted decision
ledger, so the next human or agent can continue from the correct version without
reconstructing the prior conversation.

- `../../../../../../assets/logo.svg` — canonical Proofpress page-and-seal mark for the title and end card.
- `../../../x-launch.md` — locked launch copy, beat timing, fixture language, and honesty boundaries.

- First deliver three comparable four-second motion tests of the same portable-handoff proof moment.
- Deliver both a 1920×1080 master and a separately reflowed 1080×1080 version.
- Use light, original UI/paper SFX with no narration and no music.
- Use a real, anonymized Proofpress fixture for the ledger event and verification state.

- Do not scrape or reuse the old launch demo's copy, review UI, approval controls, thousand-line diff, install command, or “Markdown gets its own Git” positioning.
- The artifact stays visually stable while sessions rotate around it.
- “Verified” applies only to computed changes and change claims. Stated why, rejected direction, and unsigned actor context remain visibly attributed.
- Do not show private paths, real actor names, internal repository names, identity/authentication chrome, access-control claims, or signed-authorship claims.
- HyperFrames owns every render-critical timeline. No generated video footage, wall-clock animation, input-driven state, or network assets at render time.
